# S3 live master dataset

These are full-client screenshots captured from the Windows Blue Archive client at 1280x720 and
100% UI scale on 2026-08-21 KST. Runtime recognition assets are not stored in this directory.

- `student_detail/sample_01.png` through `sample_03.png`: Mika basic screen, three stable repeats.
- `slot*/.../sample_*/full_screen.png`: contract-shaped copies of those source frames for Hat,
  Badge, and Watch T10/Lv70 conditions. Each copy has its own `metadata.json`.
- `equipment_menu/sample_01.png` through `sample_03.png`: the one shared equipment-growth menu,
  confirming all three Mika slots as T10/Lv70.
- `favorite_hibiki/student_detail/sample_01.png` through `sample_03.png`: Hibiki basic screen,
  confirming favorite equipment T2 in three stable repeats.

The account evidence covers real T10/Lv70, three slots, four equipment families across Mika and
Hibiki, favorite T2, and menu fallback. It does not cover equipped T1-T9, non-70 level glyphs,
favorite T1, or another client scale/resolution. Those gaps prohibit broad empirical threshold or
ROI retuning but do not block retaining the conservative unresolved-only menu fallback.
